comparison.objective: Intercept a sliding carton and push it into a marked work area.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic interception and nonprehensile planar steering without lifting.
comparison.success_condition: Carton upright, wholly inside the square and still; falling, tipping or lifting fails.
comparison.reason: Both involve observing motion, but this task reacts to object translation; it does not infer and tune a mechanism parameter over repeated physical cycles.
